# Ethixweb

> Ethixweb is a marketing agency for HVAC, plumbing and home service contractors. We build fast websites, run Google Ads and Google Local Services Ads, get contractors into the Google Map Pack, and set up AI receptionists so no call goes unanswered. We are based in Washington State, serve Seattle and the Puget Sound area, and work with contractors across the United States.

Legal entity: Ethixweb USA LLC (registered in Wyoming, United States). Contact: info@ethixweb.com. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific. We do not publish a fixed price list; scope and price are agreed in writing after a free call.

## Services

- [HVAC & plumbing marketing](https://www.ethixweb.com/hvac-plumbing-marketing): websites, Google Ads and AI lead capture for plumbing and HVAC companies
- [Google Ads & Local Services Ads management](https://www.ethixweb.com/google-ads-management): campaigns measured by cost per booked job
- [Website design for home service businesses](https://www.ethixweb.com/web-development): fast, mobile-first contractor websites
- [AI agents and AI receptionists](https://www.ethixweb.com/ai-automation): answer missed and after-hours calls, book jobs, text back
- [All services](https://www.ethixweb.com/services)
- [Industries we serve](https://www.ethixweb.com/industries): HVAC, plumbing, home services, fishing and marine charters
